newsitem.title: FRANCE: French household spending seen up in Q3,down in Q4.
newsitem.headline: French household spending seen up in Q3,down in Q4.

text.p: French household spending is expected to rise sharply in the third quarter but fall back in the fourth, reflecting a surge in third-quarter car sales, the economic research consultancy GAMA said on Friday.
Car sales have been rising sharply ahead of the expiry of a state rebate incentive scheme on September 30 and are expected to fall afterwards.
GAMA predicts a 2.1 percent increase in household spending in the third quarter from the second quarter, followed by a 2.7 percent drop in the last quarter of the year.
